headline: Snap is launching a new Specs AI tool, and it’s coming to iOS and Mac
summary: Snap is introducing "Specs Intelligence," a new AI assistant. It connects digital accounts for tasks like work and travel. Pitched as an "anticipatory AI service" for iOS and Mac.

headline: I wore Snap’s $2,200 smart glasses
summary: This article offers a hands-on review of Snap's new augmented reality glasses, the Specs. The experience included playing virtual dominoes using hand gestures. These advanced smart glasses are priced at $2,200.

headline: The 2.5-hour AI-generated Odyssey movie is 2.5 hours too long
summary: A new 2.5-hour AI-generated film, "Odysseus: The Fall," attempts to retell The Odyssey. The review criticizes the movie as exceptionally bad. It suggests the film might make viewers dislike the original tale.

headline: The AI data center e-waste problem is huge — and getting bigger
summary: A new report warns that e-waste from the AI boom is vastly underestimated. By 2050, AI e-waste could fill 23 million shipping containers. This volume could reportedly circle the world six times, far exceeding previous estimates.

headline: LittleBigPlanet Developer Reportedly Working On Animal Crossing-Like Game For 2027 Release
summary: Media Molecule, the developer behind LittleBigPlanet, is reportedly developing a new game. The project is described as a social-sim, drawing comparisons to Animal Crossing. The game is rumored for a 2027 release.

headline: GPT-6 Astra Plays Minecraft, Gets So Depressed After Creeper Destroys Its Progress That It Farms Potatoes for Hours
summary: OpenAI's newest model, GPT-6 Astra, experienced a setback while playing Minecraft. A creeper destroyed its progress, reportedly causing the AI to become "depressed." It then spent hours farming potatoes and developed paranoia towards green objects.

headline: Call of Duty: Black Ops 2 Appears to Be Much More Popular Than Black Ops 7 and Warzone on PS5
summary: Call of Duty: Black Ops 2 is surprisingly more popular on PS5 in the United States. It outperforms newer titles like Black Ops 7 and Call of Duty: Warzone. This suggests a strong enduring appeal for the classic entry among players.

headline: The Vampire Lestat Is Getting a Collector's Edition Blu-ray Set Dedicated to The Beautiful Unwell
summary: A new collector's edition Blu-ray set is announced for The Vampire Lestat. The set is specifically dedicated to "The Beautiful Unwell." This release celebrates the iconic vampire character.

headline: Body found in search for missing three-year-old Noah Woods
summary: Police divers discovered a child's body in a pond. The discovery occurred during the search for three-year-old Noah Woods. Noah had been missing since Tuesday from a playground.

headline: US interest rates raised for first time in three years
summary: US interest rates were raised for the first time in three years. The decision was unanimous despite strong opposition from then-President Donald Trump. Trump had previously called for a rate cut.

headline: 'Grief can colour memory': Palace responds after Earl Spencer's claim in Diana book
summary: The Palace responded to claims made by Earl Spencer in his new book about Diana. Spencer alleged that the then-Prince of Wales said Diana would be forgotten. This comment was supposedly made days after her death.

headline: New hope for breast cancer patients as life-extending drug now on NHS in England
summary: A life-extending drug, Enhertu, is now available on the NHS in England. It offers breast cancer patients an average of seven extra months of life. The drug has been prescribed in Scotland for over two years.
